summary: Dos remates PR345 completados y revisados independientemente: plan con firma completa estable y elegibilidad fresca; CTA solo tras preflight positivo actual. Push normal al mismo destino confirmado, descripcion PR actualizada. Core y writer intactos.

tests.command: Playwright own-transfer-confirm.spec.mjs - grupos dirigidos firma, invalidacion, UUID y controles

tests.filter: ^(solo ofrece pareja|vínculo durable|owner ausente|ambigüedad|UUID repetido|lápida|foto cambiada)

limitations: Synthetic only; no physical mobile or served beta acceptance
Preflight is not reservation or final ACK; writer unchanged
Base dependency and integration belong to coordinator; PR remains draft, reported mergeable false
Timeout and mode-transition during in-flight read have no new specific dynamic case
